Bring your AI resources together.

POST https://api.cinatoken.com/v1/chat/completions

REQUEST
{
  "model": "your-model",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Say hello."
    }
  ]
}
RESPONSE
{
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {
      "message": {
        "content": "..."
      }
    }
  ]
}

Illustrative examples only. No request is sent.

Connect your resources
Bring model providers and agent tools into a shared gateway with a consistent API.
Control access and budgets
Keep keys, workspace permissions and usage budgets connected to your account.
Understand your usage
Follow real requests, routing decisions and accounting records from one place.
An AI capability gateway built for builders

Flexible access, intelligent routing, controlled cost, and end-to-end observability.

/v1/responses
/v1/images/*
/v1/audio/*
/v1/tools/*

Send each request surface into a route pool and fail over safely across upstream targets.
